data.narrative:
Baykar is a private-stage defense and security company founded by Özdemir Bayraktar. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is not applicable. Of 22 same-sector Defense & Security peers identified, none satisfied narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), yielding zero datapoints across all three filters. A fallback to all-sector median multiples would risk material mispricing given structural differences in defense tech margins, capital intensity, and regulatory pathways relative to broader Defense & Security.

The absence of sufficiently tight comparables—particularly same-stage private defense-tech companies with disclosed financials—constrains quantitative triangulation. Without disclosed revenue, EBITDA, or capital raised figures for Baykar itself, revenue multiple or DCF approaches cannot be reliably applied. A credible valuation range cannot be established from the available data. Further work requires: (1) disclosure or estimation of Baykar's recent revenue or ARR; (2) identification of at least three disclosed peers within one valuation tier; and (3) comparable transaction multiples from recent defense-tech M&A or growth equity rounds. Until these inputs are available, a point valuation or range would be speculative.
